en: The tallest known living tree, a coast redwood named Hyperion, measures over 115 meters tall.
Some species of bamboo can grow up to 91 centimeters in a single day, making it the fastest-growing plant.
A blue whale's tongue weighs as much as an entire elephant, and its heart weighs about 180 kilograms.
A cheetah can accelerate to speeds up to 112 kilometers per hour, making it the fastest land animal.
A single ostrich egg weighs about 1.4 kilograms, which is equivalent to roughly 24 standard chicken eggs.
The human small intestine is about six meters long, which is roughly four and a half times an adult's height.
The human heart beats approximately 100,000 times per day, pumping roughly 7,500 liters of blood through the body.
Adult humans have 206 bones, but babies are born with around 270 bones that fuse together as they grow.
Coral reefs cover less than one percent of the ocean floor but support about 25 percent of all marine species.
A thirsty camel can drink up to 40 liters of water in just 13 minutes to survive desert conditions.
During the peak of spring, a single queen honeybee can lay up to 2,000 eggs in just one day.
The wandering albatross has the largest wingspan of any living bird, reaching up to 3.5 meters across.
